---
name: ci

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions: {}

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Lint
        run: make lint

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - name: Test
        run: make test

---
name: codeql

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * 1"

permissions: {}

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: python
      - name: Analyze
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3

content.text: Now update the README to reflect the new pinning scheme and Dependabot process.

input.old_string: Actions are referenced by major version tag. There is no Dependabot configuration.
input.new_string:
Actions are pinned to a full-length commit SHA, with the release version noted in a trailing comment (e.g. `actions/checkout@fbc6f39... # v5.1.0`). This protects against a tag being moved or a compromised release overwriting a version tag.

[Dependabot](.github/dependabot.yml) checks for updates to these actions weekly and opens a single grouped pull request that bumps every action's pinned SHA (and updates the version comments) at once. Review and merge that PR to pick up new action versions; don't hand-edit the `@<sha>` pins in the workflow files directly.
